MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 4
   D. 33

2. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 144
   C. 24
   D. 156

3. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

4. Solve for x: x + 7 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 8
   D. 7

5. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 9

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 42

7. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 29
   C. 3
   D. 11

8. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 1
   C. 9
   D. 21

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 81

10. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 23
   C. 17
   D. 19

11. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 64
   C. 65
   D. 16

12. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 2
   C. 14
   D. 48

13. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 72
   C. 17
   D. 73

14. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 12
   C. 13
   D. 1

15. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

16. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
